expected result: User is on the Order History page, and a delivered order with reviewable items is displayed.
testdata: User credentials: user@test.com | password: Secure@123 | Order ID: ORD-2023001-DELIVERED

description: Verify that a registered customer can successfully submit a product review and rating for a purchased and delivered item.
stepname: Click 'Write a Review' button for a purchased item within the delivered order.
expected result: The 'Write a Review' form/modal is displayed for the selected product.
evidence required: Screenshot of the 'Write a Review' form.

description: Verify that a registered customer can successfully submit a product review and rating for a purchased and delivered item.

description: Verify that a low-stock alert is triggered and displayed in the Admin inventory grid when a SKU's stock falls below its reorder threshold.
preconditions: Admin user is authenticated with the "Inventory Manager" role and navigated to the Admin portal.
stepname: Navigate to the Admin Inventory page.
expected result: The Admin Inventory page is displayed, showing a list of SKUs and their current stock levels.
evidence required: Screenshot of the Admin Inventory page.

description: Verify that a low-stock alert is triggered and displayed in the Admin inventory grid when a SKU's stock falls below its reorder threshold.
stepname: Adjust the stock of SKU 'PROD-001' to 8 units with reason 'Low stock test'.
expected result: Stock for 'PROD-001' is successfully updated to 8 units, and a success message is displayed.
testdata: SKU: PROD-001 | New Stock: 8 | Reason: Low stock test
evidence required: Screenshot of success toast message and updated stock quantity for PROD-001.

description: Verify that a low-stock alert is triggered and displayed in the Admin inventory grid when a SKU's stock falls below its reorder threshold.
stepname: Refresh the Admin Inventory page.
expected result: The Admin Inventory page reloads successfully, reflecting the latest stock adjustments.
evidence required: Screenshot of the reloaded Admin Inventory page.

description: Verify that a low-stock alert is triggered and displayed in the Admin inventory grid when a SKU's stock falls below its reorder threshold.
stepname: Verify that SKU 'PROD-001' is flagged as 'Low Stock'.
